Question 5
?

Let A={−1,0,1} and consider the relation "is greater than" (>) on A. Which of the following sets describes the relation?

a
{(−1,−1),(0,0),(1,1)}
b
{(1,−1)}
c
{(0,−1),(1,0)}
d
{(0,−1),(1,−1),(1,0)}
e
{(1,−1),(1,0)}
Submit
